name: open-owned-db-guard-dependency
body: open_owned_db resolves the registry row twice per start, once inside require_project_context and again here, and its bound open still uses ArtifactDb::open(apg_root), which names the row's worktree only because start runs the project-context guard first; collapse to one resolution and re-check the guard dependency if open_owned_db ever gains another caller.
